test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length of a rectangle is 30 cm and its width is (2)/(3) of its length. What will be the area of a square having a perimeter that is identical to the perimeter of the rectangle described here?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rectangle = 30 cm

Width of the rectangle = (2/3) of its length = (2/3) × 30 cm = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (Length + Width)

;Perimeter of a square = 4 × Side

Area of a square = Side²

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 × (30 cm + 20 cm)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 50 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 100 cm

Perimeter of the square = 100 cm

4 × Side = 100 cm

⇒ Side = 100 cm / 4

⇒ Side = 25 cm

Area of the square = Side²

⇒ Area = 25 cm × 25 cm

⇒ Area = 625 cm²

**The correct answer is option 3, 625 cm².**
